summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Report of Voting Results from its September 16, 2026 Special Meeting of Shareholders in London, Ontario. The sole matter, a reorganization resolution described in the management proxy circular, was approved with 21,915,383 votes for (99.69%) and 66,208 against (0.30%). No price, stake, premium, advisor, or structural transaction terms appear in the excerpt beyond the reorganization approval. This is a routine meeting-results disclosure, not a special situation; watch for a subsequent filing detailing the reorganization mechanics and any related capital or listing effects.
